name: SwitchToTab
label: Switch To Tab
description: Switches control to a browser tab using index, title, or partial URL.

fields.name: WebBrowserInstance
fields.label: Web Browser Instance
fields.description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

fields.name: SwitchMode
fields.label: Switch Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to locate the tab: by index, title, or URL fragment.

selectOptions.label: By Index
selectOptions.description: Switch to tab by its position (1-based).

selectOptions.label: By Title
selectOptions.description: Switch to tab by its full or partial title.

selectOptions.label: By URL Fragment
selectOptions.description: Switch to tab whose URL contains the specified text.

fields.name: TabIndex
fields.label: Tab Index
fields.description: The index (1-based) of the tab to switch to.

fields.name: TabTitle
fields.label: Tab Title
fields.description: The title of the tab to switch to.

fields.name: UrlFragment
fields.label: URL Fragment
fields.description: A partial URL (e.g., 'example.com') to match the tab.

fields.name: TimeoutSeconds
fields.label: Timeout Seconds
fields.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the tab to become available.

fields.name: CurrentTabTitle
fields.label: Current Tab Title
fields.description: Returns the title of the tab after switching.

fields.name: CurrentTabUrl
fields.label: Current Tab URL
fields.description: Returns the current URL after switching tabs.
